resources.string: Use a password for this check only. A fresh connection must match saved trust. No terminal or remote session opens; the connection closes after the check.
Profiles are loading or unavailable. Refresh to read current profiles.
Enter credentials for this endpoint. Nothing is saved.
Checking authentication. Credentials have been cleared from the fields.
Authentication succeeded; the connection was closed. Enter credentials again for a new check.
Authentication was not confirmed (%1$s). This may include a transport failure. No automatic retry was made.
Check cancelled. Enter credentials again for a new check.
The previous check ended without a confirmed result here. Already admitted bytes cannot be retracted. Enter credentials again for a new check.
Another SSH authentication operation is still preparing or retiring. No new check was queued.
Enter a username and password. Input must fit the supported length and contain valid text. Values are not trimmed or normalized.
Local network permission may be needed for this route. This check has ended and its input was cleared.
Permission request finished. Choose the profile, enter credentials again and explicitly start a new check.
